mapper.select: SELECT status::text FROM experiment_run WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND id = #{param2}
SELECT stop_requested FROM experiment_run WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND id = #{param2}
SELECT experiment_id FROM experiment_run WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND id = #{param2}
SELECT pause_kind FROM run WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND id = #{param2}
SELECT status FROM transfer_transaction WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND id = #{param2}
SELECT count(*) FROM run WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND status = 'running'
SELECT exec_phase FROM run WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND id = #{param2}
mapper.update: UPDATE run SET exec_phase = 'DISPATCH_STARTED', updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND id = #{param2} AND exec_phase = 'PREPARED'
UPDATE run SET exec_phase = 'SETTLED', updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND id = #{param2} AND exec_phase <> 'SETTLED'
mapper.select: SELECT c.code AS "capCode", count(di.id) AS "total", count(*) FILTER (WHERE ds.current_run_id IS NULL) AS "freeCnt" FROM capability c LEFT JOIN resource_capability rc ON rc.capability_id = c.id LEFT JOIN device_instance di ON di.resource_id = rc.resource_id AND di.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND di.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN device_state ds ON ds.resource_id = di.resource_id AND ds.tenant_id = c.tenant_id WHERE c.tenant_id = #{param1} AND c.id = #{param2} GROUP BY c.code

SELECT di.id AS "deviceId", di.code AS "deviceCode", ds.current_run_id AS "currentRunId", ds.current_method AS "currentMethod", r.run_no AS "runNo", COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - r.actual_start))::int, 0) AS "elapsedSec", COALESCE(( SELECT rn.estimate_sec FROM run_node rn WHERE rn.run_id = r.id AND rn.status = 'running' ORDER BY rn.id DESC LIMIT 1 ), 60) AS "nodeEstimateSec" FROM resource_capability rc JOIN device_instance di ON di.resource_id = rc.resource_id AND di.tenant_id = #{param1} AND di.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN device_state ds ON ds.resource_id = di.resource_id AND ds.tenant_id = di.tenant_id LEFT JOIN run r ON r.id = ds.current_run_id WHERE rc.capability_id = #{param2} AND ds.current_run_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY di.code LIMIT 20
SELECT status::text FROM run WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND id = #{param2}

SELECT id AS "id", seq AS "seq", workflow_id AS "workflowId", loop_count AS "loopCount", params_override AS "paramsOverride" FROM experiment_process WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND experiment_id = #{param2} ORDER BY seq
SELECT from_id AS "fromId", to_id AS "toId" FROM experiment_process_edge WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND experiment_id = #{param2}
SELECT name AS "name", default_value AS "defaultValue" FROM experiment_variable WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND experiment_id = #{param2} ORDER BY id
INSERT INTO experiment_run (tenant_id, experiment_id, status, variables, expanded_steps) VALUES (#{param1}, #{param2}, 'queued', #{param3}::jsonb, #{param4}) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE experiment_run SET started_at = COALESCE(started_at, now()) WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND id = #{param2} AND status = 'paused'

UPDATE experiment_run SET status='running', started_at=COALESCE(started_at, now()), paused_at=NULL, pause_kind=NULL, pause_reason=NULL, resumed_at = CASE WHEN paused_at IS NOT NULL THEN now() ELSE resumed_at END WHERE tenant_id=#{param1} AND id=#{param2}
UPDATE experiment_run SET current_seq=#{param3} WHERE tenant_id=#{param1} AND id=#{param2}
mapper.select: SELECT seq AS "seq", loop_index AS "loopIndex" FROM experiment_run_step WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND experiment_run_id = #{param2} AND status = 'completed'

INSERT INTO experiment_run_step (tenant_id, experiment_run_id, seq, loop_index, workflow_id, status, started_at) VALUES (#{param1}, #{param2}, #{param3}, #{param4}, #{param5}, 'running', now()) RETURNING id

SELECT count(*) FROM run_node rn JOIN run r ON r.id = rn.run_id JOIN experiment e ON e.run_id = r.id JOIN experiment_run er ON er.experiment_id = e.id WHERE er.tenant_id = #{param1} AND er.id = #{param2} AND rn.execution_resolution_status = 'reconciliation_required'
